Rs. 1,500/- per lecture; maximum Rs. 5,000/- per day and Rs. 50,000/- per month
Lecture basis, 1st Semester of Academic Session 2026-27
Offline (prescribed form to reach the Dean, COHF, Neri)

content_sections.heading: About UHF Neri
content_sections.text: The College of Horticulture and Forestry at Neri, District Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh, is a college of Dr. Y S Parmar University of Horticulture and Forestry (UHF), whose headquarters at Nauni, Solan houses the Vice Chancellor's Secretariat. The college teaches B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture and M.Sc. courses in different disciplines, and this notice is issued by the Dean of the college. The college can be reached on 01972-262901 and at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one guest faculty vacancy in one subject. The notice prints no category-wise reservation for this vacancy. The college reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The other eligibility conditions printed in the notice are: The candidate must have qualified NET/SET in the concerned discipline. The NET/SET condition is relaxable for candidates who hold a Ph.D. degree with course work and a good publication record. The college requires a teacher with a good academic record and experience; the notice does not specify the length of experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the full subject-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification_essential: M. Sc. (Horticulture) Floriculture & Landscape Architecture/ Floriculture & Landscape
rows.desirable: Ph. D. (Floriculture & Landscape Architecture/ Floriculture & Landscape)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Payment: Rs. 1,500/- per lecture. Ceiling: a maximum of Rs. 5,000/- per day and a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month. Period: the 1st Semester of Academic Session 2026-27. The engagement will be purely on lecture basis. The credit load to be assigned to the guest faculty will be determined by the department of Agricultural Extension Education on the basis of availability of a number of courses in the particular subject. The applicants will have no right to claim for their regularization.

content_sections.heading: UHF Neri Guest faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: Teaching the compulsory and supporting courses of Floriculture & Landscaping (FLS) to all the courses related to M.Sc. in different disciplines. Teaching the same courses to B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UHF Neri Guest faculty
content_sections.text: The application is made offline on the prescribed form, followed by a walk-in interview before the selection committee. Download the prescribed application form from the University website, http://www.uhf.ac.in . Fill the form complete in all respects. Send the form so that it reaches the Dean, COHF, Neri, Hamirpur 177001 (HP) by 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026 (Monday). Appear for the interview on 8 December 2026 (Tuesday) at 10.30 AM in the Committee Room of the Hon'ble Vice Chancellor Secretariat, Dr YSPUHF, Nauni, Solan. Bring all original documents and one set of self-attested copies of the certificates to the interview. The interview is held at Nauni, Solan, not at the college in Neri. No separate interview call letter will be issued, and candidates have to appear as per the schedule notified by the University.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UHF Neri Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy of guest faculty in Floriculture & Landscaping (FLS) at the College of Horticulture and Forestry, Neri.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UHF Neri guest faculty post?
faq.answer: The application on the prescribed form must reach the Dean, COHF, Neri, Hamirpur 177001 (HP) by 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the UHF Neri guest faculty post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M. Sc. (Horticulture) Floriculture & Landscape Architecture/ Floriculture & Landscape, with NET/SET in the concerned discipline. Ph. D. in the same field is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Is NET/SET compulsory for the UHF Neri guest faculty post?
faq.answer: NET/SET in the concerned discipline is required, but the condition is relaxable for candidates who hold a Ph.D. degree with course work and a good publication record.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of UHF Neri guest faculty?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, with a maximum of Rs. 5,000/- per day and Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the UHF Neri guest faculty interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 8 December 2026 at 10.30 AM in the Committee Room of the Hon'ble Vice Chancellor Secretariat, Dr YSPUHF, Nauni, Solan.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for UHF Neri Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed form from http://www.uhf.ac.in and send it, complete in all respects, to reach the Dean, COHF, Neri, Hamirpur 177001 (HP) by 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the UHF Neri guest faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on lecture basis for the 1st Semester of Academic Session 2026-27, and applicants have no right to claim regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the UHF Neri interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
